description: Normalized old-system semantic smoke for Chinese invoice optimization.
probe_scope: Generated PDF text invoice and OFD InvoiceData.xml invoice run through old Tk, old PySide6, and current invoice_cn optimizer; volatile output paths and timestamps are omitted.
comparison_implication: This fixture proves focused invoice_cn PDF/OFD field and table semantics plus the localized-title/fixed-Chinese-business-schema boundary. VIS-386 closes the finite real-invoice family through an external private masked oracle; raw private bytes and text are not fixture content.

pdf.scope: text-PDF baseline fields and table skeleton
accepted_limits: The focused generated PDF preserves core invoice identifiers across all three projects but does not produce detail rows; this matches old Tk, old PySide6, and current behavior for this simple text-layout sample.

ofd.scope: InvoiceData.xml structured fields and detail rows
table_row_lines: | 商品名称 | 规格型号 | 单位 | 数量 | 单价 | 金额 | 税率 | 税额 |

localized_title_fixed_business_schema_sc.old_tk_code_evidence: docwen-ref-tk/src/docwen/converter/layout2md/invoice_cn.py::_build_yaml_frontmatter resolves only t('yaml_keys.title', default='标题') for the generic title key, then writes the metadata dict keys unchanged from the fixed Chinese INVOICE_CN_YAML_SCHEMA/table headers.
localized_title_fixed_business_schema_sc.old_pyside6_code_evidence: docwen-ref-pyside6/src/docwen/converter/invoice/invoice_cn/markdown_writer.py::_build_yaml_frontmatter resolves only t('yaml_keys.title', default='标题') for the generic title key, while entry.py defines fixed Chinese INVOICE_CN_YAML_SCHEMA and table headers.
localized_title_fixed_business_schema_sc.current_code_evidence: packages/plugins/optimizers/invoice_cn/src/docwen_plugin_optimizer_invoice_cn/invoice_cn/markdown_writer.py::_build_yaml_frontmatter consumes yaml_key_labels['title'] for the generic title key, while yaml_schema.py keeps the 20 invoice business fields and table headers as the old fixed Chinese schema.
localized_title_fixed_business_schema_sc.parity_decision: Non-Chinese locale output should localize the generic Markdown title key for invoice_cn, but invoice business field names such as 发票代码/发票号码/价税合计 and table headers such as 商品名称 remain the old-system Chinese schema; translating those business fields would be a future product expansion, not a current parity fix.

fa13_private_final_artifact_contract_add.accepted_boundary: The three image inputs are labelled PDF derivatives rather than original camera/scanner evidence. Low absolute recognition is accepted only for non-electronic image delivery; route success, non-empty output, privacy, artifact reachability, truthful diagnostics, source immutability and current-not-worse behavior remain mandatory. Electronic PDF/OFD thresholds are unchanged.
current_repairs: Character-position reconstruction for split or combined PDF invoice headers.
Buyer/seller tax-label cluster inference without cross-column identifiers.
